settings.quiet.title: Quiet hours
settings.quiet.description: Choose when your notification emails are held. Your quiet schedule is saved on your account, applied in your own time zone — it takes effect the next time a notification is sent, and never affects other residents.
settings.quiet.enabled: Hold notification emails during my quiet hours
settings.quiet.mode_label: When should notification emails be held?
settings.quiet.mode_blocked: Held during the selected hours & days
settings.quiet.mode_allowed: Held except the selected hours & days
settings.quiet.flash_saved: Quiet hours saved — held emails are released when your quiet hours end.
settings.quiet.flash_cleared: Quiet hours cleared — all notification emails will now be sent immediately.
settings.profile_unavailable: Your profile is not available — sign out and back in.
settings.mfa.intro: Add two-factor authentication (an authenticator app) to your account. The administrator must have this on before signing in; for everyone else it is optional.
settings.mfa.enabled_status: Two-factor authentication is enabled on this account.
settings.mfa.codes_remaining_one: You have {0} unused recovery code remaining.
settings.mfa.codes_remaining_other: You have {0} unused recovery codes remaining.
settings.mfa.recovery_desc: If you lose your authenticator app, a recovery code lets you sign in once and reset your second factor.
settings.mfa.rotate_confirm: Replace your 10 recovery codes with a fresh set? The current codes stop working immediately.
settings.mfa.disable_desc: Disabling removes your second factor. If you are the only administrator on this instance, doing so removes your last defense against a stolen password.
settings.mfa.disable_confirm: Turn off two-factor authentication? If you are the only administrator on this instance, you will lose your last defense against a stolen password.
settings.mfa.disable_code_label: Enter the current code from your authenticator app to confirm
settings.mfa.codes_heading: Your recovery codes — copy them now
settings.mfa.codes_desc: These 10 codes let you sign in if you lose your authenticator app. They are shown once and cannot be recovered later.
settings.mfa.pair_desc: Add this account to your authenticator app (Google Authenticator, 1Password, Authy, or any TOTP app). Scan the QR code below, or enter the setup key manually.
settings.mfa.qr_alt: QR code to pair your authenticator app
settings.mfa.enable_desc: Enter the 6-digit code your authenticator app is showing to confirm and turn on your second factor.
settings.mfa.enable_code_label: Current code from your authenticator app
settings.sessions.intro: Manage your signed-in sessions. Signing out everywhere ends your other active sessions immediately — any other browser or device that is signed in to this account will be signed out on its next action.
settings.sessions.this_desc: You are currently signed in. Signing out everywhere below ends this session as well as every other active session for this account.
settings.sessions.kill_desc: Use this if you have signed in on a shared or public device, or if you believe another session may be compromised. Every other active session for this account is revoked immediately, and this browser is signed out.
settings.sessions.kill_confirm: Sign out of every session for this account? Your other devices and browsers will be signed out immediately.
settings.sessions.list_desc: The sessions currently signed in to this account. Revoke a session to sign out that device immediately — your other sessions are not affected.
settings.sessions.revoke_confirm: Revoke this session? Your other devices and browsers will not be affected.
settings.help_lede: Stuck on your account — a password, your access, or anything else? This guide walks you through it.
settings.timezone_lede: Pick the time zone the platform shows you. Your choice is saved on your account — it takes effect the next time you load a page, and never affects other residents.
settings.timezone_default_tail: . If you reset your preference, the platform default is used.
settings.timezone_flash_set: Time zone set to "{0}" — it takes effect on the next request.
settings.timezone_flash_reset: Time zone reset — the platform default will be used.
settings.dateformat_lede: Pick how dates and times are shown to you. Your choice is saved on your account — it takes effect the next time you load a page, and never affects other residents.
settings.dateformat_firstday_note: The day your calendar week starts on, and the day shown at the top of your day-of-week lists. Defaults to Monday.
settings.dateformat_default_tail: . If you reset your preference, the platform default is used.
settings.dateformat_custom_hint: A .NET custom datetime format string (e.g. yyyy-MM-dd HH:mm). Leave blank to use a preset.
settings.dateformat_flash_set: Date & time format set — it takes effect on the next request.
settings.dateformat_flash_reset: Date & time format reset — the platform default will be used.
settings.pagesize_lede: Choose how many items each list shows per page (feeds, events, projects and the rest). Your choice is saved on your account — it takes effect the next time you load a list, and never affects other residents.
settings.pagesize_reset_confirm: Reset your items-per-page to the platform default?
settings.pagesize_flash_set: Items per page set to "{0}" — it takes effect on the next request.
settings.pagesize_flash_reset: Items per page reset — the platform default will be used.
settings.home_lede: The home page opens with two intro sections (what Kumunita is and what it does) before the feed. Turn this on to land straight on what's new. Your choice is saved on your account and never affects other residents.
settings.home_label: Hide the intro sections and show me the feed right away
settings.home_note: When off, the home page shows its intro sections as usual.
settings.home_flash_hide: Home page updated — the intro sections are now hidden and the feed shows first.
settings.home_flash_show: Home page updated — the intro sections will show again.
settings.home_upcoming_label: Show upcoming events and to-dos on the home page
settings.home_upcoming_note: When on, the next events and to-dos appear on your home page, above the feed. When off, the home page stays as it was.
settings.home_upcoming_mine_label: Show only my own events and to-dos
settings.home_upcoming_mine_note: When on, the section lists only the events you RSVP'd to or created and the to-dos assigned to you. When off, it shows the community's events and to-dos.
settings.home_flash_saved: Home page updated — your choices are saved.
settings.security.mfa_locked_body: This is a demo account and two-factor authentication (MFA) is locked by the administrator so everyone can keep using the shared credentials. You can still use every other feature of the platform.
settings.email_lede: Pick the language the platform writes to you in — account emails and event reminders. Your choice is saved on your account.
settings.email_note: If you choose a language, your emails and reminders are sent in it. If you reset it, the instance default is used.
settings.email_flash_set: Email & notification language set — your next email will use it.
settings.email_flash_reset: Email & notification language reset — the instance default will be used.
settings.email_reset_confirm: Reset your email & notification language to the instance default?
settings.messaging.title: Messaging
settings.messaging.description: Choose whether other residents can send you direct 1:1 messages. Your choice is saved on your account and takes effect immediately.
settings.messaging.instance_off: Messaging is currently turned off on this instance by an administrator. You can opt in now and messaging will be available to you as soon as it is turned on.
settings.messaging.restricted: Messaging has been restricted on your account by a guardian. Contact them to change this.
settings.messaging.optin: Let others send me direct 1:1 messages
settings.security.title: Security
settings.quiet.clear_confirm: Clear your quiet hours? All notification emails will be sent immediately again.
settings.timezone_reset_confirm: Reset your time zone to the platform default?
settings.dateformat_reset_confirm: Reset your date & time format to the platform default?
